input: Any commit that modifies /moves/queen_d8.text must be signed by at least fourteen of the sixteen agents' keys in /team/pieces/, including queen_d8 itself, because queen_d8 has repeatedly gone off plan through greed, and every commit that modifies any /moves/<agent>.text path must also modify /turn/ply.num so a move only counts for the ply it was planned for.
response: always([+modifies(/moves/queen_d8.text) -threshold("14", /team/pieces)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/queen_d8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/queen_d8.id)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -modifies(/turn/ply.num)] false)
